structure: broad proposal → pointed accusation → clear sound bite → public responsibility
why: The continuous coaching exchange narrows a vague message into a memorable, pointed sound bite and assigns responsibility; it is complete and useful for listening to strategic phrasing.
transfer_theme: Turn a broad message into a specific public statement, then assign responsibility without overclaiming.
reusable_chunks: too broad;better sound bite;points the finger directly;keep his people in line;disorganized labor

structure: public condemnation → counterclaim → return to issue → request for apology
why: This continuous debate passage moves from a public condemnation to a counterclaim and a concrete apology request, preserving natural multi-speaker turn-taking.
transfer_theme: Condemn harmful conduct, redirect a discussion to its central issue, and make a specific request for accountability.
reusable_chunks: categorically condemn;get back to the issue;what I would like;an apology;look her in the eye

structure: funding and launch → platform → sobriety requirement → recovery accountability
why: The complete campaign-launch conversation sets a start date, introduces a platform, and turns recovery into a non-negotiable requirement; it is continuous and naturally multi-speaker.
transfer_theme: Announce a project, set a requirement, acknowledge a risk, and explain why personal follow-through matters.
reusable_chunks: campaign starts today;broad strokes;one requirement;white-knuckle your recovery;investing in yourself

why: This complete voicemail has a clean progression from identification to a progress update, an amends statement, and a restrained closing.
transfer_theme: Leave a concise update, name a responsibility you are taking, and close without demanding a response.
reusable_chunks: I don't expect you to call me back;stopped drinking;make amends;I love you and I miss you;I hope you're well

structure: false offer → refusal → moral challenge → timed exit
why: The final confrontation is one continuous exchange that escalates from a false compromise to a timed exit and preserves the scene's rhetorical pressure; keep it recognition-first because of its profanity and plot-bound hostility.
transfer_theme: State that a proposed compromise is not genuine, challenge the other side's assumptions, and set a firm time boundary.
reusable_chunks: work out a compromise;no intention of;real people with families to feed;in five seconds;I'm out of here
